people.name: Dan
people.line: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: They called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born to Israel; however the name of the city used to be Laish.
translations.bsb: They named it Dan, after their forefather Dan, who was born to Israel—though the city was formerly named Laish.
translations.kjv: And they called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born unto Israel: howbeit the name of the city was Laish at the first.
translations.asv: And they called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born unto Israel: howbeit the name of the city was Laish at the first.
